evidence.r1: Only top navigation, dates and ticket choices use glass; schedule and film content use solid surfaces in both full captures.
evidence.r2: Ticket menu replaces the red trigger and its selected row is a flat fill in both schemes.
evidence.r3: Three top control surfaces provide navigation, date choice and tickets in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Top bars and ticket menu show the same frosted material character in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear variant is visible; top controls remain frosted over the film still in both schemes.
evidence.r6: Tickets alone carries a red background with a white label at rest in both schemes.
evidence.r7: Light top navigation shows the underlying street colours through its material.
evidence.r8: Top bars are capsules and the ticket menu uses fixed rounded corners in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Ticket menu selected-row outline has a smaller inset rounding without visibly pinched corners in both schemes.
evidence.r10: Top Tickets is a capsule and its expanded choices have capsule selection outlines in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Top row separates navigation, days and ticket purchase into three groups in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Ticket menu text choices share material with the icon-only close control at upper right in both schemes.
evidence.r13: One material spans the whole date selector instead of individual glass cells in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Top navigation, date choice and tickets have large purposeful gaps and matching surfaces in both schemes.
evidence.r15: Scrolled light and dark tiles show one soft top-edge fade where programme and strands pass under the bars.
evidence.r16: Even scrolled tiles retain a varied street image behind the top controls in both schemes.
evidence.r17: The opening still sits directly under top controls at rest in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Dark ticket menu uses small black labels on mid-grey material, so the stated contrast is not visibly assured.
evidence.r19: Light reduced bars remain legible, but no increased-contrast or reduced-motion behaviour is captured.
evidence.r20: The opening still and lower programme sheet span the window width in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Scrolled tiles visibly carry programme and film content into the top bar region rather than showing clear safe-area separation.
evidence.r22: Scrolled light and dark views retain a custom photographic strip behind the floating bars.
evidence.r23: Ticket menu stills show endpoints only, not morphing or pointer-local flex, in both schemes.
evidence.r24: Top labels are black or white, while red emphasis lives on Tickets background in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Top labels avoid the still’s blue and red signage colours in both schemes.
